claims.claim: Neatly used Disc of Hitman 2 PS4 available.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the Hitman 2 PS4 case, but whether a disc is inside and its condition are not shown.
The report shows no seal or case condition that would prove it was never opened or repaired.
Photo 0 shows a game case, which has no ports and cannot overheat.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the case; pads and receipt are not shown.

risks.risk: The game disc is not inside the case.
risks.proof: A photo of the disc inside the case or the disc removed from the case.

risks.risk: The disc is scratched or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the disc data surface.

risks.risk: The plastic case is cracked, scuffed, or worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the case edges and surfaces from all sides.

risks.risk: The instruction manual or inserts are missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full contents of the case.

risks.risk: The game has not been tested and may not function.
risks.proof: A video of the game installing and running on a PS4.

risks.risk: The region compatibility is unknown (UK vs local PS4).
risks.proof: A photo of the region code on the case or disc.

proof_requests: Photo of the disc inside the case and a close-up of the disc surface.
Photos of the case from all sides showing cracks or scuffs.
Photo showing whether manuals or inserts are included.
Video of the game installing and running on a PS4.
Photo of the region code on the case or disc.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Hitman 2 PS4 game case, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's console-related claims are contradicted or unverified.
